name: Policy unclear
definition: Staff do not know, cannot find or disagree about what the travel-expense policy allows (limits, eligible items, per diem, cost centres, versions).
include: Questions about rules; contradictory guidance; outdated or English-only policy.
exclude: A claim being sent back and fixed (T3), even if a rule caused it.

name: Receipts and documents
definition: Problems with the evidence itself: lost, faded, unreadable, handwritten, foreign-language, edited or badly scanned receipts; unclear which document counts.
include: Receipt quality, missing receipts, Arabic receipts, long hotel folios.
exclude: Typing receipt data into the form (T6).

name: Rejections and rework
definition: Claims sent back, unclear rejection reasons, repeated fixes and resubmissions, checking the same claim twice.
include: Rejection comments, late-claim rejections, back-and-forth loops.
exclude: Waiting for an approver who has not looked yet (T4).

name: Approval delays
definition: Waiting for supervisors or budget owners: busy or travelling approvers, batching, no delegates, no reminders, too many approval steps.
include: Approval queues, approvers on leave, reminders, approval workload.
exclude: Not knowing who holds a claim (T5) unless the point is the approver's slowness.

name: No status visibility
definition: People cannot see where a claim is or when it will be paid, and chase by email, phone or WhatsApp.
include: Status, notifications, chasing, 'where is my money?'.
exclude: The payment run itself being slow (T7).

name: Manual entry and duplicate work
definition: Re-typing, spreadsheets, copying between systems, manual checks and manual reporting; effort out of proportion to value.
include: Data entry, re-keying, manual sampling, hand-built reports.

name: Payment timing
definition: How long reimbursement takes after approval and the personal cash-flow cost of carrying company expenses.
include: Payment runs, month-end batches, out-of-pocket, corporate cards as a fix.

name: Trust, control and AI concerns
definition: Fraud and duplicate worries, weak controls, fairness, privacy, explainability, and hopes or fears about AI tools checking claims.
include: Duplicates, split bills, auditability, 'warn not block', data location, being monitored.
exclude: Plain requests for a feature with no trust/control angle (use the pain it solves).
